scene.label: Act 4, Scene 4
scene.title: SCENE IV. The French camp. A Tent

content.text: Enter with drum and colours, Cordelia, Physician and Soldiers.

lines.text: Alack, 'tis he: why, he was met even now
lines.plainText: Alack 'tis he why he was met even now

lines.text: As mad as the vex'd sea; singing aloud;
lines.plainText: As mad as the vex'd sea singing aloud

lines.text: Crown'd with rank fumiter and furrow weeds,
lines.plainText: Crown'd with rank fumiter and furrow weeds

lines.text: With harlocks, hemlock, nettles, cuckoo-flowers,
lines.plainText: With harlocks hemlock nettles cuckooflowers

lines.text: Darnel, and all the idle weeds that grow
lines.plainText: Darnel and all the idle weeds that grow

lines.text: In our sustaining corn. A century send forth;
lines.plainText: In our sustaining corn A century send forth

lines.text: Search every acre in the high-grown field,
lines.plainText: Search every acre in the highgrown field

lines.text: And bring him to our eye.
lines.plainText: And bring him to our eye

lines.text: There is means, madam:
lines.plainText: There is means madam

lines.text: Our foster nurse of nature is repose,
lines.plainText: Our foster nurse of nature is repose

lines.text: The which he lacks; that to provoke in him
lines.plainText: The which he lacks that to provoke in him

lines.text: Are many simples operative, whose power
lines.plainText: Are many simples operative whose power

lines.text: Will close the eye of anguish.
lines.plainText: Will close the eye of anguish

lines.text: All bless'd secrets,
lines.plainText: All bless'd secrets

lines.text: All you unpublish'd virtues of the earth,
lines.plainText: All you unpublish'd virtues of the earth

lines.text: Spring with my tears! Be aidant and remediate
lines.plainText: Spring with my tears Be aidant and remediate

lines.text: In the good man's distress! Seek, seek for him;
lines.plainText: In the good man's distress Seek seek for him

lines.text: Lest his ungovern'd rage dissolve the life
lines.plainText: Lest his ungovern'd rage dissolve the life

lines.text: That wants the means to lead it.
lines.plainText: That wants the means to lead it

lines.text: News, madam;
lines.plainText: News madam

lines.text: The British powers are marching hitherward.
lines.plainText: The British powers are marching hitherward

lines.text: 'Tis known before. Our preparation stands
lines.plainText: 'Tis known before Our preparation stands

lines.text: In expectation of them. O dear father,
lines.plainText: In expectation of them O dear father

lines.text: It is thy business that I go about;
lines.plainText: It is thy business that I go about

lines.text: Therefore great France
lines.plainText: Therefore great France

lines.text: My mourning and important tears hath pitied.
lines.plainText: My mourning and important tears hath pitied

lines.text: No blown ambition doth our arms incite,
lines.plainText: No blown ambition doth our arms incite

lines.text: But love, dear love, and our ag'd father's right:
lines.plainText: But love dear love and our ag'd father's right

lines.text: Soon may I hear and see him!
lines.plainText: Soon may I hear and see him
